title: 第1章 生日第2章 恶犬第3章 变故
content_zh:
第001章 生日
今天是唐安的三岁生日，不过他现在可没有心情去理庆祝不庆祝这回事。
他的老爹老妈在家里前后忙活着，家里的丫鬟仆役来去匆匆，看到自己这个小寿星坐在门口的小竹椅子上，脸上都露出真诚的笑容。只是那笑容里多了一丝怜爱。
“少爷吉祥如意，一定会平平安安的渡过今天生日的。”
小屁孩听了这话，只是茫然的看着他们，也不说话，也不应声。那些丫鬟仆役们看了也不在意，仍旧逗弄着小屁孩，将所有的好东西都往小屁孩的眼前放，什么吃的，玩的，应有尽有。
可是，小屁孩看了，心情却更加郁闷。
这个小屁孩原本叫唐盛，身体极差，时常生病，中州城里所有的大夫都说他活不过三岁。他的老爹老娘不知道因为这事偷偷哭过几次。原本，两人都已经死心了，就准备让孩子快快乐乐的过几年算了。
直到后来，中州城来了一个有名的大师。
这位大师传说是从终南山下来的得道高人，拥有许多神秘莫测的手段，一来就治好了城门口那家几乎要夭折了的林家少爷。只是这大师，十分贪财，口碑不是很好。
不过唐家夫妇是有病乱投医，何况是自己唯一的亲生儿子。那大师再贪财，还能比自己儿子的命重要？
唐家夫妻花了无数的钱，拐了各种关系，求到了中州城的知府老爷。知府老爷出面，这位大师当真是摆足了架子，才勉强同意来唐府看看。
大师一看到这个小屁孩后，眼中顿时爆出一阵精光，可是随即又黯淡了下去，嘴里连连说着可惜可惜。
唐父唐母还以为大师说小孩子可怜，命不长久，更是禁不住又流泪了。不过大师却是捻着三寸胡须，一副神神叨叨的模样，说着这小孩命中注定长寿，可不知道为何又是一副早夭的命数。他说完，嘴里还喃喃着奇怪奇怪，不通不通啊。
小屁孩的父母没听清大师后面的话，只听到了大师说孩子长寿的那句。
一听大师如此说话，他们夫妻那一颗早已经死了的心，立马又像抓住了一点生机一般，活了！
夫妻二人连忙跪下，给大师频频磕头，哭着喊着请大师指点迷津，又奉送了大比的金银，请大师一定要帮忙救下孩子。
大师只是捋着三寸山羊须，掐着手指，说是小孩子命格异常，名字叫唐盛，未免气势太隆，可能就因此折了寿。要是改个名字，说不定会有奇迹发生。
唐父唐母早已经心灰意冷，听到大师这般说，又有林家小少爷的前例在前，顿时就跟溺水的人抓住了最后的救命稻草。唐父立马拿出大比的钱财，恳请大师帮忙给小孩子改了名字。
大师掐算了一会儿，又赐下一道平安符说是可以保孩子，将阳寿吊到三周岁生日。至于名字就取为“安”吧。自己所做的一切也无非是希望孩子平安长大。可是，大师临走时，又顺嘴说了句“唐老爷家中的翡翠玉观音漂亮非凡”，唐父当然双手奉上。
…………

今天是唐安的三岁生日，那位大师说过，孩子能不能渡过这一劫，就全看天意了。所以，唐府中人对今天都看得格外隆重。唐母在内院指挥仆役丫鬟，看到儿子病恹恹的瘦小的模样，又偷偷背过去抹了一把眼泪，心里苦极了。
“我儿可怜，但愿能平安渡过这一劫。若是我儿平安无事，为娘的折寿三十年也愿意。”
而唐安此刻穿着开裆裤，眼里无神，看着周围忙碌的人群，更是呆滞。
这里的一切，都不是他熟悉的世界。他总觉得现在自己是在做梦，可是周围那一切分明又是真的。他看着看着，忽然猛的从小竹椅子上跳了起来，小脚一下就踹开了小椅子。椅子“哐”的一声，就从走廊跌到了门外的庭院里去了。
而唐安那因为久病卧床而苍白不堪的小脸蛋，顿时也浮现出了一抹病态的嫣红。他踢开椅子，猛的往前跑了两步，站在庭院中间，忽然一手插腰，一手指天，扯着嗓门大声嘶吼道：“老天爷，你玩我！”
来往的仆人丫鬟看到小屁孩的动作，先是惊讶的停住了脚步，反应快的便“咣”的一声，把手里捧着的要送往大厅的锦盒摔在了地上。听到这一声响，其他人仿佛受到了感染一样，也“砰砰”的把手里的东西都摔在了地上。
丫鬟们也顾不得捡摔了一地的东西，扯着尖锐的嗓子，大喊着往屋后跑，边跑边喊道：“天老爷保佑！夫人，少爷站起来了！”
仆役们一撩衣摆，也飞一般的冲到了前厅去：“老爷，老爷，少爷的病好了！”
原来的小唐安体质虚弱，竟然到了三岁还不能行走的地步。怪不得所有的大夫都劝唐老爷放弃，这孩子迟早是夭折了。
而这会儿，唐安吼了两句，忽然觉得胸口发闷，气喘吁吁的想去扶台阶。可此时，他却忽然感觉到脑门一胀，一阵天昏地暗袭来。顿时，他的眼前一黑，脚也一软，便“噗通”一下昏过去了。
丫鬟仆役们看到唐安昏倒，又是一阵慌乱，各自匆忙的奔开，嘴里又喊着：“老爷，夫人，少爷不好了！”
…………
穿越，对于所有人都诡异无比的事情，就发生在今天早上。
今天是唐安的生日，不过只有他一个人生活。生日，除了他自己，也没多少人挂念。自从他的父母先后车祸去世以后，这世界对于他而言，就是孤独的了。
所以，今天的生日，对于唐安来说，也和平常一样。
7点起床，8点到公司报道，随后完成一天的工作，再下班回来，下两碗面条。日子就这么过去了，不会因为生日不生日有什么变化。可是今天早上却出了一点意外。
早上7点，唐安按时起床。脸还没洗，牙齿也没刷，甚至连自己那破旧的框架眼镜都没往脸上搁，他先开了电脑。这是他的习惯。早晨起来先天该做什么。在哪个点可以稍微的偷懒一下。不过今天，他躺在椅子上，却计划不下去了。
因为，电脑貌似出问题了！
“想体会高手是什么滋味吗？想纵横江湖，成为一代大侠，人人敬重吗？”
看着电脑屏幕上那一行鲜红的，带着浓厚杀伐意味，杀气中又隐隐透着那么一股子虚幻飘渺味道的“你就是下一个高手”的小字。以及，那巨大的三个感叹号。

唐安顿时不能淡定了！
“这什么情况？难道是昨晚下片子的时候不小心中毒了？”
于是唐安怀着忐忑的心情，慢慢的将鼠标移到了字体右上角那个叉叉的位置。
“叉！”
鲜红的字体“飘~”的一下，就消失了。
于是，唐安又淡定了。他揉了揉酸涩的眼睛，心安理得的“踢踏踢踏”圾着拖鞋往厕所里去。
可等他忙活了一会儿出来后，发现电脑又出问题了。
电脑屏幕上，此刻出现了一副，基本上看过那么一点武侠的人都能猜出来的画面。
冰凉如水的月光，洒在这紫禁之巅。紫月之下，有一个男人。白衣亮剑，迎风猎猎，长发飞舞如电，抬头，更是剑眉朗目，风靡万千少女。而这俊雅的面容中却是充斥着冰雪气息。
有一种人，已能接近神的境界。因为他已无情。有一种剑法，是没有人能够看得到的。因为曾经看到过的人都已入土。有一种寂寞，是无法描述的。因为它是源自灵魂深处的。
那个人，叫西门吹雪！
他在等叶孤城！
月圆之夜，紫禁之巅，一剑西来，天外飞仙！
“我靠，这他也太有型了！不行了，死了，死了，今天这班不去上了。翘班，我要翘班，打游戏，我要打这款游戏！就算是病毒，老子也认了！”
唐安只觉得，心里那苦苦等待未果的武侠游戏情怀，此刻又再度燃烧了起来，而且那阵势犹如野火燎原一般，一发不可收拾。
他一把拉过椅子“嘭”的坐了上去，急吼吼的就点了“开始游戏”。
屏幕下方，那一管蓝色缓冲，瞬间就飙到了满值。
画面转换了一下，一阵动听的背景音乐响起来。
伴着背景音乐，屏幕里也慢慢拉开了帷幕。
只见屏幕右边，高山流水淙淙。后面小镇浮影一派祥和。而一个男人则是潇洒的坐在一块石阶上。他的右手杵剑，身旁有俏丽女子抚琴而歌，不时回眸对着男子嫣然一笑。女子柔情似水，美的像水莲花一般令人痴醉。

“纵横江湖，美人相伴，有剑，有酒，踏歌而行。好景色，好情调，这游戏应该不错吧……”
唐安想着，迫不及待就去点新建角色。
“咦？怎么已经建好了？”
只见人物名称上那一栏，赫然就写着就是：唐安！
而人物下面却是还有一行小字介绍，密密麻麻，多的看不清楚。
“这名字怎么跟我的名字一样？难道真是病毒？”唐安磨蹭了半天，可是却怎么也无法修改名称。无奈，他只好继续下一步。他实在是想看看这优美的场景之后，到底是什么游戏！
“接下来，便是人物根骨加点。唔，这个得考虑一下。”
唐安摸着下巴，手指在下巴上捏着，忽然，他的脑中一个念头闪过。
“天下武功，唯快不破！”
可是，很快，他又觉得，这个基调是不是有点极端啊？
根骨那一栏上有四个属性选择：力量，敏捷，体质，悟性。
“唉……不管了，反正是个游戏吗？万金油的职业，我已经玩腻了，试试极端路线，也不错。”
于是，唐安就将敏捷那一项的天赋全部加到了最高点。至于其他的天赋，没办法，只能稍微低一点了。
“确定了吗？”
“确定！”
于是，在唐安点了确定之后。
没有之后了……
之后，就是现在这个模样了……

Chapter 001 Birthday
Today is Tang An's third birthday, but he is in no mood to care about celebrating or not.
His parents were busy at home, and the maids and servants at home came and went in a hurry. When they saw the birthday girl sitting on the small bamboo chair at the door, they all had sincere smiles on their faces. There was just a hint of love in that smile.
"Good luck to you, young master. You will definitely spend your birthday in peace."
After hearing this, the little kid just looked at them blankly, neither speaking nor responding. The maids and servants didn't care, they still teased the little kid and put all the good things in front of the little kid, including everything to eat and play.
However, when the little kid saw it, he felt even more depressed.
This little kid, whose original name was Tang Sheng, was in extremely poor health and often fell ill. All the doctors in Zhongzhou City said he would not live to be three years old. His parents didn't know how many times they secretly cried because of this. Originally, both of them had given up and planned to let their children live happily for a few years.
Until later, a famous master came to Zhongzhou City.
Legend has it that this master came down from Zhongnan Mountain and had many mysterious and unpredictable methods. He cured the young master of the Lin family who almost died at the gate of the city. It's just that this master is very greedy for money and his reputation is not very good.
However, the Tang family couple sought medical treatment indiscriminately due to illness, let alone their only biological son. No matter how greedy the master is, can it be more important than his own son's life?
The Tang family couple spent countless money and hired various connections to beg the magistrate of Zhongzhou City. The prefect came forward, and the master really showed off his airs, so he reluctantly agreed to come to the Tang Mansion to visit.
As soon as the master saw this little kid, his eyes suddenly lit up, but then dimmed again, and he kept saying it was a pity and a pity.
Tang's father and Tang's mother thought that the master said that the child was pitiful and would not live long, so they couldn't help crying again. However, the master was twirling his three-inch beard and talking in a serious manner, saying that this child was destined to live a long life, but for some reason he was destined to die young. After he finished speaking, he was still mumbling something strange and strange that didn't make sense.
The little kid’s parents didn’t hear what the master said clearly. They only heard what the master said about their child’s longevity.
As soon as they heard the master speak like this, the hearts of the couple that had been dead for a long time immediately came back to life as if they had grasped a little bit of life!
The couple quickly knelt down and kowtowed to the master. They cried and asked the master for advice. They also presented Dabi with gold and silver, and asked the master to help save the child.
The master just stroked three inches of the goat's beard, pinched his fingers, and said that the child had an abnormal destiny and his name was Tang Sheng. He was too powerful and might lose his life due to this. If you change your name, maybe a miracle will happen.
Tang's father and Tang's mother were already disheartened. When they heard what the master said and the young master of the Lin family had taken the lead, they immediately grasped at the last straw like a drowning person. Tang's father immediately took out Dabi's money and asked the master to help change the child's name.
The master calculated for a while and gave another peace charm, saying it could protect the child and extend his life until his third birthday. As for the name, let’s call it “An”. Everything he did was to hope that his children would grow up safely. However, before leaving, the master said, "The jadeite Guanyin in Mr. Tang's home is extraordinary." Of course, Mr. Tang presented it with both hands.
…………
Today is Tang An's third birthday. The master said that whether the child can survive this disaster depends entirely on God's will. Therefore, everyone in the Tang Dynasty regarded today as a very grand day. Tang's mother was in charge of the servants and maids in the inner courtyard. When she saw her son's sickly and thin appearance, she secretly went over to him and wiped away her tears, feeling extremely miserable.
"My son is pitiful. I hope he can survive this disaster safely. If my son is safe and sound, I will shorten my life for my mother's sake."Thirty years is also willing. "
Tang An was wearing crotchless pants at the moment, his eyes were dull, and he was even more glazed over when he looked at the busy crowd around him.
Everything here is not the world he is familiar with. He always felt that he was dreaming now, but everything around him was clearly real. As he watched, he suddenly jumped up from the bamboo chair and kicked the chair away with his little feet. The chair fell from the corridor into the courtyard outside the door with a "clang".
And Tang An's little face, which was pale due to being bedridden for a long time, suddenly showed a sickly blush. He kicked off the chair, ran forward two steps, stood in the middle of the courtyard, suddenly put his hand on his waist, pointed to the sky, and shouted at the top of his voice: "God, you are playing with me!" "
When the servants and maids who were coming and going saw the little kid's movements, they stopped in surprise at first, then reacted quickly and dropped the brocade box they were holding to the hall with a "bang" on the ground. Hearing this sound, the others seemed to be infected and dropped everything in their hands to the ground.
The maids did not bother to pick up the things that had been thrown on the floor, and ran to the back of the house shouting at the top of their lungs, shouting: "God bless you!" Madam, the young master is standing up! "
The servants lifted their clothes and rushed to the front hall like flying: "Master, master, the young master's illness is cured! "
It turned out that little Tang An was physically weak and could not even walk even at the age of three. No wonder all the doctors advised Mr. Tang to give up. The child would die sooner or later.
But at this moment, Tang An yelled a few words, and suddenly felt a tightness in his chest. He was panting and wanted to help the steps. But at this moment, he suddenly felt his forehead swell, and a burst of darkness hit him. Suddenly, his vision went dark, his feet became weak, and he fainted with a "pop".
When the maids and servants saw Tang An passed out, they panicked again and ran away in a hurry, shouting again: "Master, madam, the young master is not good!" "
…………
Time travel, something extremely strange to everyone, happened this morning.
Today is Tang An's birthday, but he is the only one living alone. Except for himself, not many people care about his birthday. Since his parents died in a car accident, the world has become lonely for him.
Therefore, today's birthday is the same as usual for Tang An.
Get up at 7 o'clock, report to the company at 8 o'clock, then finish the day's work, come back from get off work, and order two bowls of noodles. The days have passed like this, and there will be no changes because of birthdays or not. But something unexpected happened this morning.
At 7 o'clock in the morning, Tang An got up on time. Before washing his face, brushing his teeth, or even putting his worn-out glasses on his face, he turned on the computer first. This is his habit. What should you do when you wake up in the morning? At what point can you be a little lazy? But today, as he lay on the chair, he could no longer plan.
Because there seems to be something wrong with the computer!
"Want to know what it's like to be a master? Do you want to be a hero in the world and be respected by everyone? "
Looking at the bright red line of small characters on the computer screen, "You are the next master", which has a strong murderous meaning and a murderous aura that is vaguely illusory and ethereal. And, those huge three exclamation marks.
Tang An couldn't calm down anymore!
"What's going on? Could it be that I accidentally got poisoned while downloading the movie last night? "
So Tang An felt anxious and slowly moved the mouse to the cross in the upper right corner of the font.
"Fork! "
The bright red font "Gone~" disappeared once.
As a result, Tang An became calm again. He rubbed his sore eyes and walked to the toilet with his slippers on with peace of mind.
But after he came out after working for a while, he found that the computer had another problem.
on the computer screen,At this moment, a scene appeared that anyone who had seen a little bit of martial arts could guess.
The cold moonlight shines on the top of the Forbidden City. Under the purple moon, there is a man. Dressed in white and wielding a sword, he hunts in the wind, with long hair flying like lightning. When he raises his head, his sword-shaped eyebrows and bright eyes are popular among thousands of girls. But this handsome face is filled with the aura of ice and snow.
There is a kind of person who is close to the realm of God. Because he is ruthless. There is a kind of swordsmanship that no one can see. Because everyone who has seen it has been buried. There is a kind of loneliness that is indescribable. Because it comes from deep within the soul.
That person’s name is Ximen Chuixue!
He is waiting for Ye Gucheng!
On a full moon night, on the top of the Forbidden City, a sword comes from the west, and a fairy flies from the sky!
"Holy shit, he's so stylish! No, he's dead, he's dead, I won't go to class today. I'm going to skip work, I'm going to skip work, I'm going to play games, I'm going to play this game! Even if it's a virus, I'll admit it!"
Tang An only felt that the feelings of the martial arts game in his heart that he had been waiting for without success were burning again at this moment, and the momentum was like a wildfire starting a prairie fire, and it was out of control.
He pulled up the chair and sat on it with a bang, and hurriedly clicked "Start Game".
At the bottom of the screen, the blue buffer reached full value in an instant.
The screen changed, and a burst of beautiful background music sounded.
Accompanied by background music, the screen slowly opened.
I saw mountains and flowing water on the right side of the screen. The shadow of the small town behind is peaceful. And a man was sitting on a stone step coolly. His right hand is holding a sword, and beside him is a pretty woman playing the piano and singing, looking back at the man and smiling sweetly from time to time. The woman is as tender as water, and as beautiful as a water lotus, which is intoxicating.
"Across the rivers and lakes, accompanied by beauties, with swords and wine, walking and singing. Good scenery, good mood, this game should be good..."
Tang An thought about it and couldn't wait to click on the new character.
"Huh? How come it's already built?"
I saw the column with the character's name, and it read: Tang An!
But underneath the characters, there is a line of small characters introducing them, which are so densely packed that they can’t be seen clearly.
"Why is this name the same as mine? Is it really a virus?" Tang An waited for a long time, but he couldn't change the name. Reluctantly, he had no choice but to move on to the next step. He really wanted to see what kind of game was behind this beautiful scene!
"The next step is to add some character roots. Well, you have to think about this."
Tang An touched his chin and pinched it with his fingers. Suddenly, an idea flashed through his mind.
"The only martial arts in the world that can't be defeated is speed!"
However, he soon felt that this tone was a bit extreme.
There are four attribute choices in the root bone column: strength, agility, constitution, and understanding.
"Oh... no matter what, it's just a game anyway? I'm tired of playing the Tiger Balm profession. It wouldn't be a bad idea to try an extreme route."
Therefore, Tang An raised all his agility talents to the highest level. As for other talents, there is no choice but to lower them slightly.
"Are you sure?"
"OK!"
So, after Tang An clicked OK.
There is no more...
After that, it looks like this now...
